propositions: Grounding finders G1G2/E4/E6 only check the origin/main snapshot and ignore symbols that prerequisite tickets will create, causing false-positive blocking of plans with depends_on relationships.
The grammar [rebar:<ticket-id>] enables machine-parseable inline citations within plan text to ground assertions against verified upstream dependencies.

Layer-1 advisory (det_citation.py) verifies citations are backed by edges in both directions: P.depends_on(C) in P's own deps, or C.blocks(P) via reverse lookup, without adding blocking rules to det_floor.

Layer-2 LLM coverage check uses show_ticket to judge whether cited prerequisite C's plan/file_impact establishes the specific functionality claimed missing, applying fail-closed semantics (credit only if affirmatively confirmed).
Reverse-lookup exceptions from resolve_deps/show_ticket are caught and treated as unverified citations (fail-closed advisory), preventing errors from escaping the advisory lane.

Behavioral evaluation confirms Layer-2 coverage protocol credits verified+covered citations (5/5 positive samples) and withholds credit for unbacked or coverage-absent citations (5/5 negative samples), meeting >=80% threshold on both fixtures.
